contexts.text: They prostrate themselves like worms.
The transformation of caterpillars into chrysalides. AC 3000. AC 8848. HH 108:2, Described. DLW 354, Described. SE 2917. SE 3472.
Little worms... as seen under the microscope...

It vermiculated worms () = that it produced what is filthy... for worms are born from what is filthy and stinking. The falsity of evil which is in good from the proprium, is compared to a worm, because they (both) gnaw at, and thereby torment. There are two things that make Hell... evil and falsity, (and these) are what make the torment there the torment from falsity being compared to a worm. Illustrated. See AC 8478. AC 8500.
The filthiness of falsity is compared to a worm, in . ( = all such falsity and evil, in general. AC 9331:6.) ( = the falsities that will destroy. AE 638:19.)
How can bodies eaten up by worms (rise again)?
For worms come forth in minute seeds, inside nut-shells, in wood, in stones, nay from leaves.
Silkworms. Described.
Those vile worms called bees...
The worm () = torment, which is internal pain.
Man is born corporeal like a worm.
The worms called insects are born into all the knowledges of their life's loves.
The two states (of regeneration) are represented... by worms (in their two states, as caterpillars and butterflies).
Fallacies... are like worms that consume the roots...
Does the silk-worm, while it is a worm, think in its little head...
Like the light in a glow-worm.
Nor could any worms be procreated from the effluvia from the earth...
The silk-worm would perish... unless foreign worms were shaken from the leaves of its tree.
I talked with the Angels about... caterpillars when they become butterflies.
On the floor they appeared like so many wriggling worms. (Compare SE 397.)
She was reduced to this state by worms of various kinds.
The worm that smote the gourd () = the destruction of evil and the derivative falsity.
Worms were seen in the viscosity... Eagles... swallowed the worms. A worm = life from those (falsified truths and evils of life)...
